name: Gasthof Rauthof
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Rauthof in Ladis near Laudegg Castle – traditional Tyrolean cuisine with a panoramic view over the Inntal valley.
beschreibung: The Gasthof Rauthof is located right next to Laudegg Castle in the village of Ladis in the Tyrolean Oberland, in the district of Landeck. Let yourself be pampered with culinary delights in one of the cosy parlours or in the panoramic restaurant with a view over the Inntal valley; on fine days, the natural terrace below the castle invites you to linger. The cuisine combines traditional Tyrolean dishes with modern influences and regional products – from fondue and veal and pork knuckles and roast duck to home-baked bread. International dishes are also on the menu. In the afternoon there are small dishes, homemade cakes and ice cream, and much is also available to take away. For baptisms, birthdays and other celebrations, the house is happy to put together menu suggestions.
